nodes.start_phrase: Under the terms of the Amended and Restated PayPal Holdings, Inc. 2015 Equity Incentive Award Plan (the “Plan”), equity awards, including restricted stock units (“RSUs”), restricted stock awards, performance based restricted stock units (“PBRSUs”), stock options, deferred stock units, and stock payments, may be granted to our directors, officers, and employees.
nodes.summary:
- Share repurchases: In 2020, PayPal repurchased ~12 million shares for ~$1.6 billion at an average price of $136.19; $8.4 billion remained authorized for future repurchases under the July 2018 program as of December 31, 2020. Repurchased shares were recorded as treasury stock under the cost method and not retired.
- Equity incentive plans: Under the Amended and Restated 2015 Equity Incentive Award Plan, awards include RSUs, restricted stock, PBRSUs, stock options, deferred stock units, and stock payments for directors, officers, and employees. As of December 31, 2022, 47 million shares were authorized and ~31 million were available for future grants; issuances are primarily new shares.
- Inducement Plan (2022): Additional equity awards for new hires; 5 million shares authorized and ~3 million available as of December 31, 2022.
- RSUs: Pre-2022 grants vest in equal annual installments over three years; grants on/after January 1, 2022 vest 33% after one year, then quarterly through year three. Expense measured at grant-date fair value; no expiration; service-based vesting.
- PBRSUs: Earned based on performance against pre-set metrics over 1–3 years with cliff vesting after the performance period, subject to Compensation Committee approval. Expense and target shares adjust based on achievement probability; payout range 0%–200% of target.
- Stock options: All options under the plan were assumed from acquisitions and valued using the Black-Scholes model.
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP): Employees can contribute 2%–10% of pay (max $25,000/year) to buy shares at 85% of the lower of fair value at the start of the offering or end of each six-month purchase period (offering periods up to two years). ESPP shares are included in basic and diluted EPS. Purchases: 1.9 million shares at $73.20 (2022), 1.4 million at $114.36 (2021), 1.7 million at $80.36 (2020). As of December 31, 2022, ~46 million shares reserved for future ESPP issuance.

nodes.heading: 15.21.2 EMPLOYEE STOCK PURCHASE PLAN
nodes.start_phrase: Under the terms of the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (“ESPP”), shares of our common stock may be purchased over an offering period with a maximum duration of two years at 85% of the lower of the fair market value on the first day of the applicable offering period or on the last business day of each six-month purchase period within the offering period.
nodes.summary:
- Share repurchases: In 2020, PayPal repurchased ~12 million shares for ~$1.6 billion at an average price of $136.19 under programs authorized in 2017 and 2018; $8.4 billion remained authorized as of December 31, 2020. Repurchased shares were recorded as treasury stock and not retired.
- Equity incentive plans:
  - 2015 Equity Incentive Award Plan: Offers RSUs, PBRSUs, restricted stock, stock options, deferred stock units, and stock payments to directors, officers, and employees. As of December 31, 2022, 47 million shares authorized and ~31 million available; issuances primarily via new shares.
  - 2022 Inducement Plan: Additional equity program for new hires with 5 million shares authorized and ~3 million available at December 31, 2022.
- RSUs: Generally three-year vesting. Grants before 2022 vest in equal annual installments; grants on/after January 1, 2022 vest 33% after one year, then quarterly. Measured at grant-date fair value.
- PBRSUs: Earned based on performance over one to three years with cliff vesting after the period, subject to Compensation Committee approval; payout can range from 0% to 200% of target; expense adjusts with achievement probability.
- Stock options: All options under the plan were assumed from acquisitions; valued using Black-Scholes.
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP): Employees can buy shares at 85% of the lower of the offering start price or the end-of-period price, with up to two-year offerings and six-month purchase periods; contributions 2%–10% of pay, capped at $25,000/year. ESPP shares count in basic and diluted EPS. Purchases: 1.9 million shares in 2022 at $73.20; 1.4 million in 2021 at $114.36; 1.7 million in 2020 at $80.36. About 46 million shares reserved at December 31, 2022.
- RSU/PBRSU/restricted stock activity in 2022: Began with 17.5 million units; 17.2 million awarded/assumed; 9.9 million vested; 5.3 million forfeited/cancelled; 19.6 million outstanding at year-end (weighted-average grant-date fair value $133.27); 17.5 million expected to vest. - PBRSU grants: In 2022, 1.5 million one-year PBRSUs (1.0 million later cancelled due to payout method change; ~0.5 million to fully vest in February 2023) and 1.1 million three-year PBRSUs granted.
